data.title: 玛奇玛 · 遛狗
data.description: 公园草坪边，玛奇玛穿浅鼠尾草绿工装外套、象牙白高领针织衫和炭灰阔腿裤，蹲下用右手轻抚身边秋田犬的头，左手只握两条牵绳的末端；哈士奇安静站在另一侧。草地近处可见犬爪压弯的小草，旁边的石砖步道越过饮水柱延伸到木长椅，再通向树荫更浓的远处。午后日光从左上树叶间落下，照亮秋田耳尖、她的手指和外套肩部，地面反光让眼睛与狗脸仍清楚；两只犬各自的足下阴影和牵绳落影贴住草坪——「狗狗真的很棒呢。忠诚、坦率、无论何时都会全心全意地听从主人的指令……」
data.location: 城市公园草坪边，石砖步道沿饮水柱和长椅通向树荫
data.action: 蹲在两只狗之间，右手轻抚秋田犬头，左手握两条松弛牵绳末端，哈士奇站在左侧。
data.lighting: dappled afternoon light from the upper left; grass bounce keeps faces readable
data.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, crouching figure and both dogs fully within frame
data.promptProse: Two loose leashes connect the dogs beside Makima to her left hand as she crouches at the lawn's edge. Her right hand strokes the Akita's head; the husky stands quietly on her other side. A light sage field jacket, ivory turtleneck and charcoal wide-leg trousers make the pose comfortable. Keep both dogs entirely inside the medium-wide landscape view. Bent blades of grass beneath their paws occupy the foreground. A stone path runs behind them past a drinking fountain and wooden bench, narrowing into deeper tree shade. Afternoon sun enters through foliage from the upper left, lighting the Akita's ear tips, her fingers and jacket shoulder. Grass-reflected light keeps the dogs' faces and her ringed eyes visible; distinct paw shadows and thin leash shadows stay attached to the lawn rather than floating beneath them.
